name: Dew Drop Gel Cleanser
short: A light gel that lifts away oil and sunscreen without leaving skin tight.
description: A pH-balanced gel cleanser that foams softly to remove makeup, sweat and excess sebum. Skin feels clean, fresh and comfortable, never stripped.
howToUse: Massage onto damp skin for 60 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water. Use morning and evening.

name: Oat Milk Cream Cleanser
short: A creamy, soothing wash that cleanses while leaving a soft moisture veil.
description: Colloidal oat and squalane cleanse gently and calm redness. A comforting first step for dry or reactive skin.
howToUse: Apply to dry or damp skin, massage in circles, then rinse or wipe off with a soft cloth.

name: Rose Water Balancing Toner
short: An alcohol-free toner that refreshes and preps skin for serums.
description: Damask rose water and hyaluronic acid hydrate and rebalance skin after cleansing. Layer it for extra glow.
howToUse: Pat onto clean skin with hands or a cotton pad. Follow with serum and moisturizer.

name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
short: 15% stabilized vitamin C to brighten dark spots and boost radiance.
description: A lightweight antioxidant serum that visibly fades uneven tone and protects against daily environmental stress.
howToUse: Apply 3-4 drops to clean skin in the morning, then finish with moisturizer and SPF.

name: Hyaluronic Acid Hydration Serum
short: Three weights of hyaluronic acid for deep, plump, lasting hydration.
description: Multi-molecular hyaluronic acid draws water into every layer of skin for a bouncy, dewy finish without stickiness.
howToUse: Apply to damp skin morning and night, then seal with a moisturizer.

name: Niacinamide 10% Clarifying Serum
short: Minimizes the look of pores and balances shine and blemishes.
description: 10% niacinamide with zinc helps regulate oil, refine texture and fade post-blemish marks over time.
howToUse: Apply a few drops to the whole face morning or night, before moisturizer.

name: Ceramide Barrier Moisturizer
short: A rich cushiony cream that repairs and protects the skin barrier.
description: Three essential ceramides plus cholesterol and fatty acids rebuild the barrier and lock in moisture for 48 hours.
howToUse: Smooth over face and neck as the last step of your routine, morning and night.

name: Green Tea Water Gel Cream
short: An oil-free, bouncy gel that hydrates and soothes without heaviness.
description: Antioxidant-rich green tea and aloe deliver weightless moisture, ideal for humid weather and oily skin.
howToUse: Apply an almond-sized amount to face and neck after serum.

name: Daily Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50
short: Broad-spectrum zinc oxide protection with no white cast.
description: A sheer, fragrance-free mineral SPF 50 PA++++ that wears comfortably under makeup and is reef-friendly.
howToUse: Apply generously as the final morning step and reapply every 2 hours in direct sun.

name: Overnight Retinol Night Cream
short: Encapsulated retinol that smooths fine lines while you sleep.
description: Time-released 0.3% retinol with peptides and ceramides refines texture and firmness with minimal irritation.
howToUse: Use 2-3 nights a week at first, then increase gradually. Always wear SPF the next day.

name: Matcha Purifying Foaming Cleanser
short: Antioxidant-dense Japanese matcha wash that clarifies congested pores.
description: Infused with ceremonial-grade organic matcha and salicylic acid, this refreshing foam dissolves impurities and controls midday oiliness.
howToUse: Dispense 1-2 pumps, gently massage over wet face, then rinse thoroughly with cool water.

name: Apricot Glow Jelly Cleanser
short: Luminous apricot nectar jelly that gently melts away dull skin.
description: A bouncy gel-to-milk cleanser powered by apricot kernel oil, gentle PHA, and vitamin C that leaves skin glowing and supple.
howToUse: Massage onto dry skin to dissolve makeup, add warm water to emulsify into milk, then rinse clean.

name: Cica & Centella Calming Toner
short: Relieves irritation and restores moisture balance with pure centella.
description: Formulated with 84% Centella Asiatica extract and soothing madecassoside, this calming botanical toner calms flare-ups and reinforces stressed barriers.
howToUse: Pour onto clean palms or soak a cotton pad, then gently press into the face and neck until absorbed.

name: BHA Clarifying Hydrating Toner
short: Gently clears blackheads and refines pore texture with 2% BHA.
description: A dual-action liquid exfoliant with betaine salicylate, willow bark, and hyaluronic acid to smooth bumpy texture while keeping hydration locked in.
howToUse: Apply 2-3 times a week at night after cleansing. Follow with a hydrating serum and moisturizer.

name: Milky Rice Ceramide Essence Toner
short: Nourishing rice bran milk that delivers deep cushiony glow.
description: Rich in fermented rice bran extract and barrier-strengthening ceramides, this silky milky toner softens rough flakes and imparts glass-skin luminosity.
howToUse: Shake well before use. Pat 2-3 layers onto clean skin morning and night for an ultra-plump finish.

name: Multi-Peptide Copper Firming Serum
short: Concentrated copper peptides to visibly firm, smooth, and rejuvenate.
description: An advanced anti-aging complex featuring 1% Copper Tripeptide-1, Matrixyl 3000, and Argireline to stimulate collagen synthesis and restore youthful bounce.
howToUse: Smooth 3-4 drops over face and neck morning and evening before heavier creams.

name: Cloud Cushion Squalane Day Cream
short: Whipped cloud-like cream delivering all-day weightless hydration.
description: Plant-derived sugarcane squalane and snow mushroom extract melt seamlessly into skin without greasy residue, keeping your complexion soft from sunrise to dusk.
howToUse: Gently massage an almond-sized amount onto face and neck as your morning moisturizer.

name: Peptide Deep Restorative Night Balm
short: Velvety sleeping recovery balm for deep overnight barrier renewal.
description: A deeply conditioning melt-in balm with multi-peptides, marula oil, and bisabolol to cocoon parched, tired skin in soothing nourishment overnight.
howToUse: Warm a dime-sized amount between fingertips and press into skin as the final step of your nighttime routine.

name: Hydrating Sun Gel SPF 50+
short: Ultra-light cooling sun gel with zero white cast and invisible finish.
description: A high-performance broad-spectrum SPF 50+ PA++++ chemical sunscreen with 8 types of hyaluronic acid. Absorbs like a refreshing water essence.
howToUse: Smooth 2 finger lengths evenly over face and exposed skin 15 minutes prior to sun exposure.

name: Matte UV Defense Sun Stick SPF 50+
short: Portable on-the-go sun stick with pore-blurring matte finish.
description: Pocket-friendly broad spectrum SPF 50+ stick formulated with silica powder and artemisia to absorb oil and reapply over makeup without clumping.
howToUse: Twist up and glide across forehead, cheeks, and neck. Reapply every 2 hours outdoors.

name: Radiant Tinted Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+
short: Universal sheer tint mineral SPF with a radiant golden glow.
description: 100% non-nano zinc oxide tinted formula that evens out redness, blurs minor imperfections, and shields against UVA, UVB, and blue light.
howToUse: Dispense 1-2 pumps and blend evenly with fingertips for a luminous skin-like finish.

name: Clarifying Salicylic Blemish Treatment
short: Fast-acting 2% salicylic acid solution to clear breakouts overnight.
description: Targeted blemish-fighting serum that penetrates deep inside pores to dissolve sebum plugs, reduce inflammatory redness, and speed up recovery.
howToUse: Apply 1 drop directly onto blemishes or a thin layer over breakout-prone zones at bedtime.

name: Ruby Lactic & AHA Peeling Solution
short: 10-minute facial peel to visibly smooth texture and brighten tone.
description: A potent blend of glycolic, lactic, and tartaric acids suspended in Tasmanian pepperberry and red beetroot to unveil baby-soft luminosity in just 10 minutes.
howToUse: Apply to clean, dry skin. Leave on for no more than 10 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with warm water. Use once weekly.

name: Eye Revive Ultra-Hydrating Cream
short: Firms delicate under-eye contours and brightens stubborn dark circles.
description: Rich in clinical caffeine, triple peptides, and squalane to depuff morning eye bags, smooth crow's feet, and awaken fatigued eyes.
howToUse: Gently tap a rice-grain amount around orbital bone using your ring finger morning and night.
